cues.text: Aigis's room in the dorm, with a large reclining machine chair beside her and ammunition boxes stacked against the wall. You stand facing Aigis. Spent shell casings lie scattered across the floor.
Aigis holds out a small charred screw, and you take it from her.
You step closer to Aigis. She glances down and lifts a hand to her cheek.
You step up to Aigis and gently take her hand.
